sector.narrative: Structural transformation, including green, inclusive and digital transitions

condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

description.narrative: - Landings from fisheries either certified sustainable or making regular, verifiable improvements. - Number of fisheries for the targeted commodities (tuna, large pelagics, blue swimming crab) that are sourced by SFP partners and their suppliers and that are either in a FIP or MSC certified. - Additional number of international seafood buyers (‘buyers’ = SFP partners plus suppliers to SFP partners) with sustainable seafood purchasing policies - Number of position statements issued by industry for IATTC and WCPFC that include support of more effective CMMs for tuna, sharks and LPF at the regional level. - Number of Sustainable Marine Commodities Platforms created with project support and functional - Number of Sustainable Fisheries Action or Management Plans under implementation as a result of project support - Number of FIPs uploaded to FisheryProgress.org, have progressed by at least one grade, or have maintained an ‘A’ grade with project support - Additional private investment in FIPs - Number of additional fisheries in certification process (have entered process, undergoing assessment, or have been certified) - MSC & FishSource scores - Number of registered users - Number of visitors - Level of satisfaction (in terms of meeting user expectations) of information users for each site - Number of scientific reports published by technical experts contracted by the project - Number of visitors of best practice documents - Level of utility of best practice documents
